xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4592: Opt-in Semgrep GitHub Actions workflow via pan semgrep ci-setup, with failure relay

plan.title: Opt-in Semgrep GitHub Actions workflow via pan semgrep ci-setup, with failure relay
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: 20 files, but the finalize lint counts each top-level doc and manifest path (configuration/, cli/, docs/, changelog.d/, scripts/, packages/contracts/, sync-sources/skills/) as its own group, giving 10. The code is two areas, src/lib/semgrep (two new modules) and the CI relay (two files), plus the standard CLI registration set for a new verb. Splitting would separate a CLI verb from the skill, manifest and docs that lint:skills, lint:slash-commands and agent-text-cli-verbs require to ship with it.

narratives.Problem: Overdeck's Semgrep support (PAN-4585, PAN-4590, PAN-4591) scans only on the local machine. A user cannot add a Semgrep GitHub Actions check to a project from Overdeck, and a red Semgrep CI job reaches the work agent only as a generic CI failure whose log excerpt is built for Vitest output.
narratives.Proposal: Add 'pan semgrep ci-setup <project>' (plus the pan-semgrep skill), which renders a pinned, diff-aware Semgrep workflow carrying the project's gate mode in OVERDECK_SEMGREP_GATE and opens a PR from branch overdeck/semgrep-ci through a detached throwaway worktree, never touching the base branch. In blocking mode a PR that adds a finding fails the semgrep job; in advisory mode the job always concludes green and only warns, so no merge-verdict reader needs changing. Add isSemgrepCheckName, a Semgrep findings excerpt, and Semgrep fix/suppression guidance to the CI failure relay. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4592.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to ADVISORY_CHECK_NAMES, src/lib/advisory-checks.ts, or any merge-verdict reader (pr-facts.ts, github-app.ts, webhook-handlers.ts, derived-issue-state.ts, ready-set.ts, auto-merge-scheduler.ts, strike-review.ts)
- CI does not follow later security.semgrep.gate or verification.sast changes; the operator edits OVERDECK_SEMGREP_GATE
- No dashboard button, HTTP route or no-loss matrix row (#4594 owns dashboard Semgrep UI)
- No Semgrep Platform tier, semgrep ci, or SEMGREP_APP_TOKEN (#4593)
- No GitHub branch-protection change; ci-setup never marks semgrep required on GitHub
- No update or removal of an existing .github/workflows/semgrep.yml
- No GitLab CI support and no polyrepo sub-repositories
- No change to the local sast gate or its config keys
- No push to the base branch and no local branch created in the user's primary checkout

autoDecisions.summary: Advisory vs required is rendered into the workflow (OVERDECK_SEMGREP_GATE) instead of adding 'semgrep' to ADVISORY_CHECK_NAMES
autoDecisions.rationale: ADVISORY_CHECK_NAMES is process-wide and the merge verdicts that matter ignore it: pr-facts summarizeStatusCheckRollup counts every row, and toChecksState feeds ready-set, the auto-merge scheduler and strike review; a per-project list would need every reader changed (two of them at the 1000-line ceiling). A green job is advisory to every reader by construction.

autoDecisions.summary: Gate mapping: blocking stays blocking; advisory and off render as advisory; resolved once at ci-setup time
autoDecisions.rationale: An off gate must never fail CI; the operator edits one env line to change it later, and the local sast gate keeps following the config live.

autoDecisions.summary: Advisory runs are not relayed to the work agent
autoDecisions.rationale: The job concludes green, matching the local sast gate where advisory findings are not rework.

autoDecisions.summary: Pull requests are scanned diff-aware (--baseline-commit at the merge base); pushes are scanned only with --sarif-upload and never fail
autoDecisions.rationale: Whole-tree PR scans would fail every PR in blocking mode on repos with existing findings; a red main empties Overdeck's merge gate. Verified in semgrep/semgrep:1.180.0 against a scratch repo.

autoDecisions.summary: Use --sarif-output=semgrep.sarif and keep the text report on stdout
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified in the container; the relay excerpt needs the human-readable report.

autoDecisions.summary: SARIF upload to GitHub code scanning is opt-in via --sarif-upload
autoDecisions.rationale: Upload needs security-events: write and, on private repos, GitHub Advanced Security; least privilege by default.

autoDecisions.summary: The generated commit and push use --no-verify from a detached throwaway worktree under OVERDECK_HOME/tmp, with OVERDECK_PAN_GIT_OP=1
autoDecisions.rationale: A fresh worktree has no installed dependencies, so repository hooks cannot run; precedents exist in uat-generation-deps.ts and planning-promotion.ts; OVERDECK_PAN_GIT_OP lets an agent run the command past its git guard; no local branch is created.

autoDecisions.summary: ci-setup requires security.semgrep.enabled true, a GitHub single-repo project whose origin is github_repo, and never overwrites an existing workflow
autoDecisions.rationale: Parent FR-1 (one block turns the feature on); polyrepo, forks as origin, GitLab and workflow updates are outside the issue's scope.

autoDecisions.summary: CLI and skill only; no dashboard button or HTTP route
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue scopes 'pan semgrep ci-setup <project> (plus skill wrapper)'; dashboard Semgrep UI belongs to #4594.

autoDecisions.summary: The workflow pins semgrep/semgrep:<SEMGREP_VERSION> (1.180.0), actions/checkout@v4 and github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
autoDecisions.rationale: Same engine as the local gate (parent NFR-5); tag verified on Docker Hub; checkout@v4 is what this repo's workflows use.

autoDecisions.summary: CI carries security.semgrep.severity as --severity flags, scans Dependabot PRs, and makes the SARIF upload step non-fatal
autoDecisions.rationale: Plan critique round 1: keeps blocking CI at the local gate's threshold (verified in the container), avoids a silently unscanned PR class, and keeps advisory and push runs green when an upload fails.

Render the Semgrep GitHub Actions workflow with the gate mode and strict input validation

metadata.acJustification: Six criteria: the workflow text is the security-sensitive core of the feature, and each criterion pins one independently reviewable property (exact text, parsed structure, gate line, SARIF variant, severity mapping, validation).

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-3: new pure module src/lib/semgrep/ci-workflow.ts exporting SEMGREP_WORKFLOW_PATH, SemgrepCiGate (options include severity), validateCiConfigs, validateBaseBranch, ciGateForMode and renderSemgrepWorkflow, producing exactly the PRD WI-3 YAML (pinned semgrep/semgrep:<SEMGREP_VERSION>, pull_request trigger, no job-level if: (Dependabot PRs are scanned), contents: read, --severity flags from security.semgrep.severity per D17, job env OVERDECK_SEMGREP_GATE/SEMGREP_ENABLE_VERSION_CHECK/SEMGREP_SEND_METRICS/BASE_REF, fetch-depth 0, the D5-verified scan script). With sarifUpload: a push trigger on the base branch (JSON.stringify), security-events: write and actions: read, and the upload-sarif@v3 step with continue-on-error: true. Only the configs and the base branch are interpolated, after validation. Add src/lib/semgrep/__tests__/ci-workflow.test.ts.

items.title: Given configs ['p/default', '.semgrep/'], base 'main', gate 'advisory', severity 'ERROR', no upload and version 1.180.0, renderSemgrepWorkflow returns text equal to the PRD WI-3 example

Given the example options, the rendered YAML parses with container image 'semgrep/semgrep:1.180.0', permissions exactly { contents: 'read' }, only a pull_request trigger, no 'if' key on jobs.semgrep, and a run script that contains '--metrics off', '--error', '--sarif-output=semgrep.sarif', '--baseline-commit' and '--severity ERROR' and no '${{'
Given gate 'blocking', the rendered text differs from the advisory text only in the line 'OVERDECK_SEMGREP_GATE: blocking'

Given sarifUpload true, the rendered YAML has on.push.branches ['main'], permissions including 'security-events: write', and an upload step using 'github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3' with continue-on-error true
Given severity 'WARNING', both scan lines contain '--severity WARNING --severity ERROR'; given severity 'INFO', no line contains '--severity'

validateCiConfigs rejects 'auto', '/abs/rules.yml', '--config', 'p/default;rm -rf x', '../rules' and an empty list and accepts 'p/default', 'r/python.lang.security', '.semgrep/' and 'rules/custom.yml'; validateBaseBranch rejects 'main;x' and '$(x)' and accepts 'release/1.2'; ciGateForMode maps off and advisory to 'advisory'
